info.name: Calisthenics AI Backend
info.description: Complete API collection for Calisthenics AI Backend: Authentication, User Management, Coach & Client Profiles, Exercise Catalog, Workout Plans, Coach-Client Sharing, Persistent Workout Sessions, Real-Time Chat, AI Form Analysis, and File Storage.

request.description: Create a local account and save the returned access token and refresh token.
Authenticate with email & password and retrieve JWT access and refresh tokens.
Refresh an expired access token using the valid refresh token.
Authenticate and auto-provision user using a Firebase ID token.
Clear user security context session.
Get profile of the currently authenticated user.
Update full name, avatar URL, or experience level for the current user.
Retrieve all registered users (requires ROLE_ADMIN).
Get current user's Coach profile.
Create or update current user's Coach profile.

request.description: Get editable default schedules for PPL, UPPER_LOWER, and FULL_BODY.
Create a plan and all ordered exercise assignments atomically. A day can contain any number of exercises.
Retrieve all workout plans created by the authenticated user.
Retrieve the selected plan and its Monday-to-Sunday schedule.
Replace the plan configuration atomically. Include an exercise assignment id returned by GET/POST to preserve it during an edit or reorder.
Delete the selected workout plan.
List exercises scheduled for a specific weekday in the plan.
Attach a catalog exercise to a specific day.
Batch reorder and update all exercises scheduled for a specific workout day in one transaction.

Remove an assigned exercise from the day schedule.
